scientific_integrity: The two periodic orbits and local types are prior results of arXiv:2610.09176v1. Its Section 4 already describes a basin-separating separatrix numerically for one parameter. The new claim concerns parameter-uniform global completeness, rigorous two-ended finite backward-time singularities and leading three-coordinate asymptotics; no claim of authorship, independence or expert validation.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the explicitly defined family for \(0<\mu\le588/6575\). No Hurwitz Jacobian property is asserted outside the source-established open parameter region. Backward blow-up endpoint times, heights and phases are not explicitly evaluated. The phase and height expansions are branchwise and not uniform as mu tends to zero. Literature priority is not independently adjudicated.
title: Finite-backward-time ends of the basin separatrix in a Hurwitz polynomial flow
